description.narrative: The project will help the Government of the Philippines boost local government revenue mobilization to improve local public service delivery and strengthen local governance. The focus will be on improvements to the administration of the real property tax (RPT) and on management reforms.

Output: Institutional development and policy support for property valuation strengthened Indicator: Policies, rules, and regulations for RPT reforms drafted Progress/Status: The following implementing rules and regulations have been prepared:
Philippine Valuation Standards (PVS), 3rd Edition. A total of 1,336 copies of the PVS were distributed to BLGF Regional Offices, provinces, cities, and municipalities. Of these, 652 hard copies were released in February, while 684 copies were distributed in March. Distribution of PVS to the remaining LGUs is ongoing.
Local Assessment Manual (LAM). LAM was promulgated through DOF Circular No. 004.2025, dated November 5, 2025, and published in a newspaper of General Circulation on January 14, 2026. Distribution of the LAM to LGUs is ongoing through the LAM Rollout. To date 1,722 out of 1,800 copies have been delivered.
Mass Appraisal Guidebook (MAG), 2nd Edition. Following the incorporation of DOF comments, the manual was resubmitted to DOF on 18 May 2026 for approval. Target printing date is Q3 2026.
Assessment Evaluation Examination and Monitoring Manual (AEEMM). The concerned expert submitted the latest draft of the manual and is currently undergoing. Target date for printing is Q3 2026.
Real Property Tax Compliance and Impact Study (RPTCIS) Guidebook. The draft is for final review of the management. The target printing date remains set for Q3 2026.
Manual on the Evaluation of Local Treasury Operations (MELTO). The final draft with inputs and suggestions during the Final Exposure Workshop has been submitted to Management for review and approval. Likewise, the purchase order dated 28 May 2926 has been approved in preparation for printing. Target printing is Q3 2026. Data Source: Copies of RPT policies and instruments (e.g. manuals and procedures) issued Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not drafted Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not drafted Target year: 2026 Target value: drafted

Service delivery ability and local governance performance of LGUs improved

Number of LGUs meeting BLGF revenue collection efficiency targets reached 80% (3-year rolling average) Achievement: 94.6 Progress/Status: Achievement as of Q2 2026 progress report: 44.43% or 762 LGUs reached their revenue collection targets as of FY2025.
For the 20 Pilot LGUs of the project, 20% or 4 LGUs have reached their RPT revenue collection targets, based on the preliminary Q4 FY2025 RPT collections.
Among the 4 LGUs that achieved their targets, 3 are those with updated SMVs and completed general revisions.
As of FY 2025, 44.43% (762 LGUs) achieved their RPT targets. Data Source: BLGF Revenue Collection Efficiency Reports

LGU's dependency on national tax allotment (NTA) reduced to 75% Achievement: N Progress/Status: Across all LGUs, NTA dependency as of FY2025 stands at 66%.
The 11 LGUs with updated SMVs and completed general revisions have an NTA dependency of 72%.
In comparison, the 20 pilot LGUs collectively show an NTA dependency of 74%. Data Source: BLGF's Electronic Statement of Receipts and Expenditures Actual value: N

Total own-source LGU revenues increased by 30% in nominal terms over 2017 baseline Achievement: 331.093 billion Progress/Status: As of FY2025, total LGU own-source revenue was ₱391.38 Billion or 91% increase from FY 2017 collections.
Revenue for FY2025 Q4 across the 20 pilot LGUs is ₱14.04 Billion, reflecting an increase of ₱6.15 Billion or 78% compared to the baseline revenue.
The 11 LGUs with updated SMVs and completed general revisions reported ₱5.48 Billion for FY2023 baseline revenue. Their revenue for FY2025 Q4 increases by 97% (₱7.07 Billion). Data Source: BLGF local government financing performance monitoring system Baseline value: Php 206 billion
